procedure_name: Mobility and Periodic Registration Update Failure Handling for Emergency Services
description: UE procedures for handling failures during mobility and periodic registration updates for emergency services, either initiating a new emergency PDU session or performing an emergency services fallback.

properties.description: UE attempts mobility and periodic registration update for emergency services.
UE analyzes the reason for registration update failure.
Network rejects the registration update (as described in 5.5.1.3.5).
UE receives an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.
Specific abnormal cases defined in 5.5.1.3.7 occur.
UE follows procedures defined in subclause 5.5.1.3.5.
UE follows procedures defined in subclauses 5.4.1.2.2.11, 5.4.1.2.3.1, 5.4.1.2.3A.1 or 5.4.1.3.5.
UE follows procedures defined in subclause 5.5.1.3.7.
UE informs the upper layers of the failure.
UE performs de-registration locally and attempts initial registration for emergency services.
UE is still in the same PLMN
Abnormal Case b) in 5.5.1.3.7
Abnormal Cases c), d), e), or g) in 5.5.1.3.7
UE doesn't attempt E-UTRA/EPC or 5GCN selection, AND is camped on NR/E-UTRA connected to 5GCN in the same PLMN (Emergency Fallback scenario).
UE attempts to register for emergency services.
Follow procedure in 5.5.1.3.5
Follow authentication failure procedure
